descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologia informației și servicii informatice
We are looking for an experienced Senior .NET Developer with strong expertise in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable software applications. The ideal candidate will have solid experience with the Microsoft .NET ecosystem, modern software architecture, and backend development, as well as the ability to collaborate with international teams. Fluency in German is required.
Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable applications using C# and .NET.
Build and integrate RESTful APIs and backend services.
Develop and maintain microservices-based architectures.
Work with relational and non-relational databases.
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, following best practices and design principles.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to architectural decisions.
Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders and international colleagues.
Participate in Agile development processes and technical discussions.
Ensure software quality through automated testing and continuous integration.
 Requirements 
5+ years of professional experience in .NET development.
Strong knowledge of C# and the .NET / .NET Core ecosystem.
Experience with ASP.NET Core and REST API development.
Good understanding of object-oriented programming, SOLID principles, and design patterns.
Experience with SQL databases and Entity Framework Core.
Knowledge of microservices architecture and distributed systems.
Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Familiarity with unit testing and automated testing frameworks.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within an international team.
 Fluent German (B2/C1 level) and good English communication skills. 
 Nice to Have 
Experience with Microsoft Azure or AWS.
Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with frontend technologies such as Angular or React.
Familiarity with message brokers such as RabbitMQ or Kafka.
Experience with automated testing tools and DevOps practices.
